title: The Studio Phone
summary: A night radio host hears the studio phone ring in a city that has gone silent.

beats.text: At three in the morning, the studio phone rang. Nobody had that number.
I'm Wren, night host at Gull Hill Radio.
My roof's siren speakers shout my every word. And the infected follow sound.
The streets below had filled. One loud word would bring them up my hill.
"Hello? Is anyone there? Please don't shout. They're right outside."
beats.speaker: tilly

beats.text: Tilly was a child, hiding in the school at the bottom of the hill.
Three of them stood outside, listening.
A full-volume answer would shout her location to them all.
Beside the studio door hung the speaker switch. I flipped it off.
I leaned in and whispered, "Tilly, I'm here."
Then every speaker on the roof said it back.
